entities.name: Devin
entities.description: A Faerie Noble of the Great Wood on Ulgrotha who served as leader, ambassador and diplomat.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Created Devin in the likeness of Veldrane of Sengir.

entities.name: Veldrane of Sengir
entities.description: Person in whose likeness Devin was created.

entities.name: An-Havva
entities.description: Human town with which Devin handled diplomacy.

entities.name: Joskun
entities.description: The An-Havva constable who respected Devin.

entities.name: Great Wood
entities.description: Home of the faeries Devin led.

relations.note: Created in the likeness of Veldrane of Sengir.
relations.quote: Created by the Autumn Willow in the likeness of Veldrane of Sengir
He never questioned the motives of the Autumn Willow
earning him respect from figures like Joskun
